title: Geometric Spin–Statistics under Weakened Assumptions
exact_target: Find a geometric derivation of spin and statistics and identify which weaker physical assumptions still force their usual relation.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000343 (OWR-1109-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Noncommutative Geometry and Quantum Field Theory (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/48, pp. 2705--2760; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 34--35, printed pages 2738--2739.
Spin--statistics and projective modules; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The nonrelativistic bundle framework is the context. Topology alone permits a choice of exchange sign and does not automatically prove the physical relation; the report explicitly requires an additional physically motivated input. The two source questions remain separate.
